meta.title: Sagar Kashyap | Software Developer
meta.description: Sagar Kashyap — Software Developer specializing in React, Next.js, Node.js, ASP.NET Core and AI-powered applications.

hero.name: Sagar Kashyap.
hero.description: Software Developer with experience building full-stack applications, internal ERP systems, dashboards and AI-powered applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, ASP.NET Core and modern AI tooling.

bullets: Worked on the development of a new internal ERP system, contributing to system architecture, backend services and frontend workflows used by multiple departments.
Introduced Redux Toolkit and RTK Query to stabilize frontend state management and improve UI and data consistency.
Built reusable UI components including dynamic tables, configurable dropdowns and shared form validation utilities.
Developed and integrated core ERP modules using ASP.NET Core, SQL Server and React with TypeScript.
Wrote and maintained unit tests for frontend and backend components using Jest and Moq.
Developed an admissions dashboard with filtering and reporting features while working closely with backend APIs and optimizing SQL queries.
Assisted in migrating an existing React application to Next.js, including routing changes, SSR setup and basic build optimizations.
Improved application maintainability by refactoring legacy components and increasing component structure and reusability.
Worked on a live real-estate web portal, housingmagic.com, contributing to frontend features and backend integrations.
Wrote and maintained API documentation using Swagger Hub to support internal development and onboarding.
Integrated the Google Maps API to implement location-based property search and nearby property discovery.

items.name: YT RAG
items.description: A RAG-powered learning assistant that provides semantic search across WDS videos and articles and answers questions using relevant content with grounded references.
built: Semantic search using AI embeddings, PostgreSQL and pgvector.
Context-aware AI assistant that retrieves relevant content chunks.
Grounded references to video timestamps and article sections.
Durable workflows for ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retries and database persistence.
GitHub OAuth and rate limiting for secure access and controlled AI/API usage.

items.name: Syllabrain
items.description: An AI-powered textbook and syllabus platform that uses OCR and LLMs to transform images into structured learning content.
built: AI syllabus platform using LLMs and OCR.
Converted images into structured learning content.
Generated structured JSON hierarchies covering semesters, modules and units.

items.name: AI Whiteboard
items.description: An AI-powered collaborative whiteboard that helps users visually organize ideas, generate content, and interact with their canvas using natural language.
built: Interactive whiteboard with support for drawing, shapes, text and visual elements.
AI assistant that interprets natural-language instructions and generates or modifies whiteboard content.
Integrated LLM-powered workflows for transforming user ideas into structured visual content.
Implemented real-time canvas interactions with a responsive and intuitive editing experience.
Built reusable frontend components and backend APIs for managing whiteboard state and AI operations.
